title: Card Recovery Authorization on the Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan
content:
**Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan — the standing authorization for card autorecovery.**

The standing authorization for card autorecovery is the worker's own consent: only the worker grants or revokes it, and the desk never sets it on the worker's behalf.

- The authorization can be granted only while the worker's Paystride Visa Payroll Card Account status is active. A worker with no Paystride card, or whose card is issued but not activated, blocked or closed, cannot grant it.
- Revocation, which the worker may make at any time whatever the card's status, takes effect for attempts not yet booked; a recovery already booked stands.
- When the worker's card account closes, the authorization lapses and is set to false.

| Action | Card account active | Card not active or none held |
|---|---|---|
| Grant | permitted, by the worker | not permitted |
| Revoke | permitted, by the worker | permitted, by the worker |
